Finding the right breast pump shouldn't be complicated. At Momcozy, we've helped over 3 million mothers in 60+ countries on their breastfeeding journeys. We know every mom needs something different: exclusively pumping moms need power, working moms need discretion, and new moms need comfort .
This Momcozy breast pump comparison guide walks through our full lineup, which now spans five families: the W Series (warm-massage wearable), Air Series (ultra-slim wearable), M Series (smart wearables), S Series (classic wearables), and the V Series (hospital-grade pumps). The family now includes the new warm-massage W1 and the hospital-grade V3 (plug-in) and V3 Pro (cordless) — so whether you need a discreet pump for the office or strong suction at home, this Momcozy pump comparison has you covered.
To make choosing easier, we've organized our pumps into distinct families. Each series has a different design philosophy, but all are built to give you freedom, comfort, and the ability to "get back to feeling like yourself".
The W Series (W1) : Our comfort-forward family, launched with the W1 — the industry's first warm-massage wearable breast pump. Gentle heat and rhythmic massage work with suction to encourage let-down and comfort.
The Air 1 Series : Our newest model, designed to be the slimmest and most discreet pump on the market.
The M Series (M5, M6, M9) : These are our all-in-one comfort models, focusing on ergonomic design, gentle suction, and a "painless" pumping experience.
The S Series (S9 Pro, S12 Pro Quick) : Our classic and beloved wearable pumps. These are the reliable workhorses of our collection, known for their efficiency and long battery life.
The V Series (V1 Pro, V2 Pro, V3, V3 Pro) : Momcozy V series breast pumps have tubing to connect motor and milk collector. The family now adds the plug-in hospital-grade V3 and the cordless V3 Pro — both with Dual-Pump Dual-Control and five built-in rhythms.
Let's dive into a detailed Momcozy breast pump models comparison.
The W Series is Momcozy's comfort-forward wearable family. It launches with the W1 , the industry's first warm-massage wearable breast pump — built for moms who want gentle warmth and soft rhythmic massage working alongside suction to encourage let-down and comfort.
Momcozy W Series — At a Glance
Warm-Massage Sync (HugWave™ + SoftPulse™)
Warm-Massage Sync, Massage, Expression, Mixed + Milk Boost/Milk Relief; app
Low supply, comfort seekers, warm-compress lovers
Momcozy W1 — Warm-Massage Wearable Breast Pump
The Momcozy W1 (model BP420) is a hands-free wearable pump with industry-first Warm-Massage Sync technology. Exclusive HugWave™ wave rhythm and SoftPulse™ massage deliver 3 levels of warmth (38–40°C) and 3 levels of rhythmic massage that sync with the pumping cycle. It reaches up to 295 mmHg across 12 levels (or 15 levels × 3 speeds in pro mode), holds 180 ml , weighs 280 g , and runs about 10 sessions per charge (6 with warmth on). All settings — warmth, massage, mode, and milk tracking — live in the Momcozy app.
Design, Flange, and Milk Collector
The W1 is an all-in-one in-bra unit about 2.8" thick, with food-grade BPA-free silicone cups and a 24 mm flange plu

s 17/19/21 mm inserts for a snug fit. The 180 ml collector means fewer interruptions, and Type-C charging takes about 2.5 hours.
Motor, Suction, Modes, and Pumping Settings
Five modes cover the day: Warm-Massage Sync, Massage, Expression, Mixed, plus Milk Boost and Milk Relief. Suction tops out at 295 mmHg with 12 levels (or 15 × 3 speeds), and the motor stays under 50 dB. The app lets you fine-tune warmth and massage without breaking your rhythm.
What is Momcozy W1 best suitable for?
The W1 is ideal for moms with low or sluggish supply who benefit from warmth and massage, moms with sensitive or engorged breasts who want a gentler let-down, and anyone who wants app-controlled comfort during every wearable session. It pairs especially well with a hospital-grade pump at home for moms who need both comfort on the go and power at the nightstand.
Momcozy Air Series — At a Glance
App control, wireless charging case (up to 15 sessions)
Working moms, travel, ultimate discretion
The Momcozy Air 1 was crafted for one primary purpose: ultimate discretion. It is the thinnest, most premium wearable pump we've ever designed, made for the mom who needs to pump absolutely anywhere without a second thought. It's the pump that is truly "in-bra, under the radar".
The slim profile of the Air 1 is its defining feature, allowing it to be worn under clothing almost invisibly. But its design is about more than just aesthetics. We integrated a transparent top-view window, which solves one of the biggest challenges of wearable pumps : nipple alignment. You can look down and ensure perfect placement every time, optimizing efficiency and preventing discomfort.
The flanges are made from an incredibly soft 50A silicone, designed to gently conform to all breast shapes and sizes for a secure, comfortable, and leak-free fit.
The Air 1 is as smart as it is sleek. It features an ultra-quiet motor that operates at less than 45dB, so you can pump confidently in a silent room or on a work call. It integrates fully with the Momcozy app, allowing you to switch modes, track sessions in real-time, and even get notifications when the collector is full.
Perhaps its most convenient feature is the wireless charging case. This case doesn't just store your pumps; it charges them. A single charge of the case can provide up to 15 pumping sessions or 5 days of use, effectively eliminating cord clutter from your daily routine.
What is Momcozy Air 1 best suitable for?
The Air 1 is the ideal choice for the busy, modern mom who prioritizes discretion. This is for the executive pumping in an open-plan office, the mom running errands, or the parent who wants to pump on a plane or at a social event without anyone knowing. It is our premium, high-tech, "invisible" solution.
Momcozy Air 1 Ultra-slim Breast Pump
Momcozy Wellness 1 Warm-Massage Wearable Breast Pump
The M Series is our "All-in-One Comfort" line. These pumps ( M9 , M6 , and M5 Smart ) are designed to be as simple and gentle as possible. They are all-in-one units, meaning the motor and milk collector are a single, compact piece that fits in your bra, with no external motors, tubes, or wires.
Momcozy M Series — At a Glance
15 levels, 2 pro modes (Milk Relief™, Milk Boost™) + 3 standard, app
Data-driven moms, supply tracking
Simple all-in-one (Mobile Style™)
Gentle baby-mouth (horizontal)
3 modes (upgraded Mixed), 9 levels, app
Sensitive nipples, lightweight
The Momcozy M9, or Mobile Flow™, is the "smart" pump designed for data-driven moms. Its defining feature is advanced app integration that puts complete control and tracking at your fingertips.
The M9 features a sleek all-in-one design—motor and collector integrated into a single unit that fits discreetly in your bra with no wires or tubes. The transparent Tritan collector is durable, highly transparent, and resistant to over 100 boiling cycles, while DoubleFit™ soft silicone flanges (24mm with 17mm/19mm/21mm inserts) ensure a secure, comfortable seal. The 150ml capacity s

upports longer sessions without frequent emptying.
The M9 delivers hospital-grade suction up to -300mmHg with a 3rd-gen motor operating whisper-quiet at under 42dB. Through the app, access 15 suction levels, personalized preferences, plus 2 professional modes (Milk Relief™ and Milk Boost™) and 3 standard modes. The app automatically tracks duration, output, and production trends, with alerts when sessions complete. A 12-minute quick charge provides power for one full pumping session.
What is Momcozy M9 best suitable for?
Ideal for tech-savvy moms who want optimization through data, working moms needing smart tracking and reminders, moms building supply who want to monitor trends, and anyone who prefers app-based control over manual settings.
Momcozy Mobile Flow™ Hands-Free Breast Pump | M9
M9 Bra Bundle: M9 Breast Pump and YN46 Nursing Bra
The Momcozy M6, or Mobile Style™, balances ergonomic comfort, sleek design, and straightforward simplicity. It's built for moms who want reliable, efficient pumping without complicated features—just stylish functionality that works.
The M6's streamlined, ergonomic design stays nearly invisible under clothing, tested on over 1,000 moms to ensure discreet, comfortable all-day wear. The all-in-one construction integrates motor and collector into a lightweight unit (10.12 oz) that won't weigh you down. Soft silicone flanges adapt to your breast shape for a secure seal, while the 6.09 oz capacity handles generous output. With only 4 accessories to wash, cleanup is remarkably simple.
The M6 features a 2nd-generation motor delivering powerful suction from -285 to -300mmHg with 3 modes (Stimulation, Expression, Mixed) and 9 adjustable levels. The optimized pumping rhythm—perfected through feedback from 1,100+ moms—balances gentle suction with natural frequency for comfortable, effective sessions. Simple button controls make adjustments effortless, with no app required. The 180-minute battery provides 5-6 sessions per charge, supporting full-day freedom.
What is Momcozy M6 best suitable for?
Perfect for moms who value simplicity and ease of use, appreciate stylish ergonomic design, want straightforward controls without app connectivity, and need comfortable all-day wearability. Ideal for busy schedules requiring a "just works" solution.
Momcozy Mobile Style™ Hands-free Slim Breast Pump | M6
The Momcozy M5 Smart is our upgraded flagship comfort pump, combining our famous "baby-mouth" suction with new smart technology. It features a unique horizontal pumping angle that mimics a baby's natural latch, offering a gentle and pain-free experience that you can now control entirely from your phone.
The M5 Smart uses a horizontal angle inspired by how babies naturally nurse, which helps reduce discomfort and increases milk flow. Weighing only 8 ounces, it is 1/3 lighter than most pumps and fits invisibly inside your bra with no wires or tubes. The soft silicone flanges (24mm with 17mm/19mm/21mm inserts) adapt comfortably to your shape, and the collector holds a generous 120ml+ of milk.
Best-seller M5 is now M5 Smart !
Connect to the Momcozy App to track volume and control sessions from your phone.
The M5 Smart features 3 modes, including an upgraded Mixed Mode that stimulates and expresses at the same time for a faster letdown. You can choose from 9 adjustable suction levels, all while the pump stays whisper-quiet (under 50dB). The biggest upgrade is the Momcozy App connectivity, allowing you to track milk volume and control your settings from your smartphone. The battery lasts for 6-7 sessions (100-120 minutes) and includes a 30-minute auto shut-off for safety.
What is Momcozy M5 Smart best suitable for?
The M5 Smart is perfect for tech-savvy moms who want to track their breastfeeding journey, moms with sensitive nipples who need a gentle touch, and anyone wanting a lightweight, truly hands-free solution that's easy to use anywhere.
M5 Smart Bra Bundle: Double M5 Smart Breast Pump and Nursing Bra(YN21)
The V

Series features a unique separated-motor design with tubing to connect the motor and milk collector. The defining characteristic of this series is its design: the motor is a separate, portable unit that connects to the in-bra collection cups via slim, discreet tubing.
Why this design? It's a breakthrough in physics. By moving the heavy motor off the breast, the in-bra collection cups become incredibly lightweight and comfortable. It also allows us to use a much larger, more powerful motor for superior performance.
Momcozy V Series — At a Glance
Hospital-grade, separated-motor
Plug-in hospital-grade, Dual-Pump
5 built-in rhythms, 15 levels, app
At-home supply building, exclusive pumpers
Cordless hospital-grade, smart
5 rhythms + adaptive suction, app
At-home + portable, smart reliability
Momcozy V1 Pro - Hospital grade suction breast pump
The Momcozy V1 Pro is our powerhouse and only true hospital-grade pump. Its breakthrough separated-motor design delivers maximum suction power for moms who need serious efficiency to establish or maintain full milk supply.
The V1 Pro's revolutionary design separates the motor from the collection system—a portable motor unit connects to lightweight in-bra cups via slim, flexible tubing. This separation is transformative: removing the heavy motor makes the cups incredibly comfortable for extended wear while allowing for a larger, more powerful motor. The DoubleFit™ soft silicone flanges (24mm with 17mm/19mm/21mm inserts) ensure proper fit, while integrated collectors prevent milk backflow for hygienic collection.
The V1 Pro delivers genuine hospital-grade suction up to -300mmHg—the same power found in clinical pumps. The 3rd-generation motor offers 3 fine-tuned rhythms that mimic baby's suckling patterns at different hunger levels, plus 15 adjustable suction levels for complete customization. The 2300mAh battery supports up to 9 sessions per charge, ensuring reliable performance throughout your day without constant recharging.
What is Momcozy V1 Pro best suitable for?
Ideal for exclusively pumping (EP) moms, moms of twins or multiples needing maximum efficiency, moms building or increasing supply through power pumping, and anyone requiring hospital-grade performance with mobility freedom.
V1 Pro Hospital-Strength Wearable Breast Pump
V2 Pro Hospital-Strength Wearable Breast Pump - Ultra-light & Potent
Momcozy V2 Pro - Portable breast pump
The Momcozy V2 Pro features the same innovative separated-motor design as the V1 Pro, optimized for ultimate portability. It delivers powerful, efficient suction in a whisper-quiet, ultra-compact package designed for busy, on-the-go moms.
Like the V1 Pro, the V2 Pro uses a separated-motor design with a lightweight, pocket-sized motor unit connecting to in-bra collection cups via slim tubing. The motor is exceptionally compact and portable, easily slipping into purses or pockets. The lightweight cups remain comfortable under clothing for discreet pumping anywhere. DoubleFit™ soft silicone flanges (24mm with 17mm/19mm/21mm inserts) provide secure, leak-free seals, while integrated collectors ensure hygienic milk collection.
The V2 Pro delivers strong suction up to -288mmHg—powerful enough for efficient milk expression while operating at whisper-quiet levels under 48dB. It offers 3 pumping modes (including milk supply building and stimulation) and 9 adjustable suction levels, giving ample customization for comfort and efficiency. The ultra-quiet operation makes it perfect for pumping in shared spaces, during meetings, or while traveling without drawing attention.
What is Momcozy V2 Pro best suitable for?
Perfect for working moms returning to the office needing efficient pumping during breaks, moms frequently on-the-go requiring portable power, moms valuing discretion in shared spaces, and anyone wanting strong performance in a lighter, quieter package than traditional hospital-grade pumps.
Momcozy V3 — Plug-In Hospital-Grade Breast Pump
The Momcozy V3 is a plug-in

hospital-grade pump built for serious supply work at home. Its Dual-Pump Dual-Control design runs two independent channels so each breast gets its own setting, and SoftStart™ ramps suction up gradually to protect sensitive nipples. It reaches about -270 mmHg and ships with five built-in rhythms — Cozy Flow, Power Pumping, Milk Boost, Lactation Starter, and Deep Emptying — all adjustable across 15 levels in the app. A closed system and roughly 4 hours of battery backup keep sessions uninterrupted, and optional wearable cups add hands-free freedom.
What is Momcozy V3 best suitable for?
The V3 suits exclusively pumping moms, moms of multiples, and anyone building or rebuilding supply who wants consistent hospital-grade power at home. It is the "big host" anchor of a two-pump setup: pair it with a wearable like the Air 1 or W1 for life outside the house.
Momcozy V3 Pro — Cordless Hospital-Grade Breast Pump
The Momcozy V3 Pro keeps everything moms love about the V3 and cuts the cord. It is a cordless, rechargeable hospital-grade pump with the same Dual-Pump Dual-Control power and five built-in rhythms, plus StableFlow™ smart pressure stabilization and adaptive suction that hold consistent vacuum as the milk flows. A brightness-adaptive night light and a premium waterproof carrying bag make it ready for bedroom sessions and travel alike.
What is Momcozy V3 Pro best suitable for?
The V3 Pro is for moms who want hospital-grade performance without being tied to a wall — perfect as the at-home "big host" that also travels. Like the V3, it pairs naturally with a wearable pump for daytime outings.
The S Series is our "Classic Wearable" family. These are the beloved, reliable pumps that made Momcozy a top-selling brand in North America. In this design, the motor sits directly on top of the milk collector, creating a simple, compact, and highly effective wearable unit. They are celebrated for their powerful suction, ease of use, and fantastic value.
Momcozy S Series — At a Glance
LED screen, 210 ml collector, 3-step clean
Massage / Expression / Mixed, 9 levels
The Momcozy S12 Pro Quick is the high-efficiency model of the S series. It features a clear, smart LED screen that allows you to easily see your mode, suction level, and battery life at a glance. With 3 modes and 9 suction levels, it offers a highly customizable and efficient pumping session, making it a favorite for moms who want to "set it and forget it" with confidence.
What is Momcozy S12 Pro Quick best suitable for?
Ideal for moms who want a reliable, customizable workhorse pump with clear visual feedback, moms seeking strong suction and efficiency at an excellent value, and those who prefer straightforward controls with LED display over app connectivity.
The S12 Pro Quick (model BP360) is our upgraded classic wearable. It keeps the clear LED screen and 9 levels you liked, and adds a larger 210 ml collector, a ≤46 dB quiet motor, a Mixed mode (stimulation + expression together), a memory function, and a DoubleFit™ hybrid flange for a better seal — all at the same $139.99 double-pump price.
The Momcozy S9 Pro is the workhorse of the S series, and its defining characteristic is its upgraded, long-lasting battery life. It's designed to give you more pumping sessions on a single charge than ever before. This makes it the perfect "go-bag" pump, a reliable backup, or the primary choice for a busy mom who doesn't have time to be tethered to a charger.
What is Momcozy S9 Pro best suitable for?
Perfect for busy moms who need extended battery life without frequent charging, moms wanting a reliable backup or travel pump, and anyone seeking a dependable, no-fuss wearable pump at the best value in our collection.

Start with the setup most moms wish they'd known sooner: a big host pump at home plus a wearable on the go . A full-size pump like the V3 or V3 Pro delivers hospital-grade suction and complete sessions at your nightstand, while a wearable such as the Air 1 or W1 keeps you consistent at work, in the car, or on a trip. They are teammates, not rivals — together they cover every hour of your day.
Then match the details to your life:
Maximum discretion at work or travel: Air 1 (ultra-slim, in-bra) or W1 (warm-massage comfort).
Data and app control: M9 or M5 Smart for tracking, reminders, and trends.
Simple, no-app reliability: M6 or S12 Pro Quick.
Best-value workhorse: S9 Pro for long battery life on a budget.
Serious supply building at home: V1 Pro, V3 (plug-in), or V3 Pro (cordless). If you are building or rebuilding supply , a hospital-grade pump is your strongest ally.
Flange fit matters most: measure your nipple and add 1–3 mm — the AAP guide to pumping is a good reference.
If you pump three or more times a day, keep two pumps — a big host (V3 or V3 Pro) at home and a wearable (Air 1 or W1) for outings — so you never miss a session. The smartest long-term value is often this two-pump pairing, covering you from week one through weaning.
Clean pump parts that touch milk after every use, and sanitize daily. Good hygiene protects your baby and keeps suction strong — see the CDC's breast-pump hygiene guidance .
After every use: disassemble flanges, valves, membranes, and collectors; rinse in cool water; wash in a dedicated basin with warm soapy water; rinse; air-dry on a clean paper towel.
Once a day: sanitize by boiling, steam, or UV. The motor and tubing (V Series) are never washed.
Replace on schedule: valves and membranes every 2–4 weeks, diaphragms every 1–2 months, and V Series tubing every 3–6 months. Worn silicone is the most common cause of lost suction — not a defect.
Most pump problems trace back to a few easy fixes. If you hit a snag, work through these first — for safety background, see the FDA's breast-pump notes :
Low or dropping suction: check flange fit, then inspect valves and membranes for stretches or tears and replace them. A loose collection cup or cracked part also leaks pressure.
Unusual noise or vibration: re-seat the motor and tubing (V Series) and confirm parts are fully locked in.
Pump won't start / auto shut-off: charge fully, clean the charging contacts, and confirm the lid or sensor isn't blocked.
Skin discomfort: re-measure your flange size; pain usually means the wrong fit, not the pump.
If the motor itself fails, that is a warranty matter — email support@momcozy.com with your proof of purchase. Many "fixes" are just worn sili

cone parts, which are inexpensive to replace and not covered by warranty.
Motor warranty: 1 year in the US and 2 years in the EU from delivery, covering manufacturing defects (not wear-and-tear or accidental damage).
Accessory replacement: valves, membranes, diaphragms, flanges, and tubing are available to order, and small silicone parts are meant to be replaced regularly.
User guides: setup, cleaning, and troubleshooting manuals for every model are in the Momcozy pump help center.
Insurance & DME partners: many pumps are available at little to no cost through partners such as Aeroflow, 1 Natural Way, and Babylist Health ( Aeroflow ). Under IRS rules , pumps are HSA/FSA-eligible medical expenses.
Direct support: the care team answers at support@momcozy.com for warranty, parts, and use questions.
Choosing your pump is step one. Succeeding with it is step two. Here are the answers to the most common questions our pumping moms ask.
Where to buy Momcozy breast pumps?
You can purchase our full line of breast pumps, including the new Air 1, M5, and V1 Pro, directly from our official website at Momcozy.com. We also have an official store on Amazon.
We also want to make our pumps as accessible as possible. Most Momcozy breast pumps are medical devices and are HSA/FSA eligible, allowing you to purchase them using pre-tax dollars.
Can I get a Momcozy breast pump through insurance?
Yes ! We are proud to have partnered with leading Durable Medical Equipment (DME) providers to help you get a Momcozy breast pump at little to no cost through your insurance. Thanks to the Affordable Care Act (ACA), most health insurance plans are required to cover the cost of a breast pump.
Verify Coverage : Contact your insurance provider to confirm your breast pump benefits .
Obtain a Prescription : Get a prescription for a breast pump from your OBGYN or healthcare provider.
Choose a DME Partner : We work with trusted partners like Aeroflow, 1 Natural Way, Babylist Health, and many others. You can visit our insurance page to see the full list. Your chosen DME partner will handle all the paperwork and claims for you.
How to choose the right flange size for Momcozy breast pumps?
This is the single most important factor for a comfortable and efficient pumping experience. An incorrect flange size is the number one cause of pain and can reduce your milk output.
The Golden Rule: Measure your nipple, then add 1-3mm.
Here is the correct way to measure:
Stimulate : Gently stimulate your nipple so it perks up (do not measure a flat nipple).
Measure : Using the nipple ruler included in your Momcozy pump set, find the hole that your nipple fits through snugly without being squeezed. Alternatively, use a ruler to measure the diameter (the width) of the base of your nipple in millimeters (mm). Do not include your areola.
Calculate : Take your nipple measurement and add 1 to 3 millimeters to find your ideal flange size. For example, if your nipple base measures 21mm, your ideal flange size is 24mm. If your nipple measures 18mm, you should use a 21mm flange insert.
Check Both : Your nipples may be different sizes, so be sure to measure both!
How to clean Momcozy breast pumps?
Proper hygiene is essential for your baby's health.
The Golden Rule : Any part that comes into contact with breast milk (flanges, valves, membranes, milk collectors) must be cleaned after every single use. The pump motor and tubing (for V-series) never get washed.
After Every Use : Disassemble all milk-contacting parts.
Rinse them in cool running water immediately to remove milk residue.
Wash gently by hand in a dedicated wash basin (not the sink) with warm, soapy water.
Air Dry completely on a clean paper towel or drying rack. Do not use a cloth towel, as it can transfer germs.
Once Per Day : All washed parts should be sterilized at least once every 24 hours. You can do this by boiling the parts, using a steam sterilizer, or using an all-in-one washer/sterilizer/dryer like the Momcozy KleanPal Pro.
T

he "Fridge Hack" : In a pinch, you can place your used, unwashed pump parts in a sealed, clean bag and store them in the refrigerator. This is acceptable for up to 4 hours between sessions, but it is not a replacement for cleaning. You must still wash and sterilize all parts at least once per day.
What is the warranty on Momcozy breast pumps?
We proudly stand by the quality of our products. Your Momcozy breast pump motor comes with a 1-year warranty in the US (and 2 years in the EU) from the date of delivery.
This warranty covers manufacturing defects or failures caused by "non-human factors". It does not cover normal wear-and-tear, accidental damage, or "breast pump accessories".
It's important to know that small silicone parts like valves and membranes are designed to be replaced regularly. Over time, they can stretch and wear out, which can cause a loss of suction. This is not a warranty issue! Replacing these inexpensive parts every 1-3 months will keep your pump working like new.
If you believe your pump motor has a true warranty issue, please keep your proof of purchase and contact our customer service team at support@momcozy.com.
Can I use a Momcozy wearable pump and a hospital-grade pump together?
Yes — and most frequent pumpers should. The most effective setup is a big host pump at home (the V3 or V3 Pro) for complete, supply-building sessions, plus a wearable like the Air 1 or W1 for work, errands, and travel. They cover different parts of your day, so you rarely miss a session. Think of them as teammates, not an either/or choice.
Finding the right breast pump is a personal decision, but it doesn't have to be a stressful one . This Momcozy breast pump comparison is designed to empower you with the knowledge to make the best choice for your body, your baby, and your lifestyle.
There is no single "best" breast pump. There is only the pump that is best for you.
Whether you are an exclusively-pumping mom who needs the unwavering power of the V1 Pro, a busy working mom who needs the invisible discretion of the Air 1, or a new mom who needs the gentle comfort of the M5, your perfect match is here . This is your unique journey. We're just honored to be a "cozy" part of it.
And remember the setup most moms love: a big host pump at home (the V3 or V3 Pro) paired with a wearable on the go (the Air 1 or W1). Together they cover every scenario — from a quiet office pump to a serious supply session at your nightstand.
